title: Jacob Goes to Egypt

questions.question: Where did God speak to Jacob on his way to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:1 (ESV): "So Israel took his journey...and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac."

questions.question: Did God tell Jacob not to be afraid to go to Egypt?
options: God told him not to go
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:3: "Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for there I will make you into a great nation."

questions.question: How many of Jacob's family went to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:27: "All the persons of the house of Jacob who came into Egypt were seventy."

questions.question: Who did Jacob send ahead to Joseph?
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:28: "He had sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to show the way before him in Goshen."

questions.question: What did Jacob say when he met Joseph?
options: Now let me die, since I have seen your face
questions.correctAnswer: Now let me die, since I have seen your face
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:30: "Israel said to Joseph, 'Now let me die, since I have seen your face and know that you are still alive.'"

questions.question: What promise did God make to Jacob at Beersheba?
options: He would make him a great nation and bring him back
questions.correctAnswer: He would make him a great nation and bring him back
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:3-4: "I will make you into a great nation...I will also surely bring you up again."

questions.question: What did Joseph instruct his brothers to tell Pharaoh?
options: They were shepherds and keepers of livestock
questions.correctAnswer: They were shepherds and keepers of livestock
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:34: "You shall say, 'Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth.'"

questions.question: Why did Joseph want them to say they were shepherds?
options: So they could dwell in Goshen since shepherds were an abomination to Egyptians
questions.correctAnswer: So they could dwell in Goshen since shepherds were an abomination to Egyptians
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:34: "Every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians" — this would keep them separate in Goshen.

questions.question: How did Joseph greet Jacob?
options: He presented himself, fell on his neck, and wept
questions.correctAnswer: He presented himself, fell on his neck, and wept
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:29: "Joseph prepared his chariot and went up to meet Israel his father in Goshen. He presented himself to him and fell on his neck and wept on his neck a good while."

questions.question: Who promised to close Jacob's eyes (be with him at death)?
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:4: "I myself will go down with you to Egypt, and I will also bring you up again, and Joseph's hand shall close your eyes."

questions.question: How many descendants came through Leah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:15: "All the persons of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three."

questions.question: Who were the sons of Benjamin listed in this chapter?
options: Ten sons including Bela, Becher, and others
questions.correctAnswer: Ten sons including Bela, Becher, and others
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:21: Ten sons of Benjamin are listed including Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, and others.

questions.question: Who were Joseph's sons born in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:20: "And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim."

questions.question: How many descendants came through Rachel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:22: "All the persons of Rachel were fourteen."

questions.question: In what visions did God speak to Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:2: "And God spoke to Israel in visions of the night."

key_verse_text: Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for there I will make you into a great nation.
